messages:
ada: Quick check — onboarding payload for zeta-13b landed in S3 but tokenizer flags don't match HF manifest. Path: s3://redwood-artifacts/onboard/zeta-13b/2026-03-10/payload.tar.lz4. Registry manifest claims sha256:aa11b22c33d44e55f66a77b88c99d00e, but S3 head-object MD5 looks like d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e (empty-file hash). Also tokenizer.json on S3 has "pad_token": null while upstream lists 0. Anyone owning the manifest or can re-run the mirror?

mike: I kicked off the mirror last night, it reported success but that MD5 being the empty-file hash is a red flag. Mirror logs show the upload step completed but file size logged as 0B. Likely a multipart finalization bug for that shard. I can re-run the job with a different client and confirm.

sophia: HF origin for this model is huggingface.co/org/zeta-13b (commit b7e9). Tokenizer change landed there two commits ago — we need to pull tokenizer.json from that commit to avoid pad_token mismatch. Also note registry manifest version is still "v1"; our serving loader treats v1 as legacy and rewrites pad_token -> 0, which masks the mismatch unless you explicitly validate.

jordan: @mike @sophia can someone generate a presigned URL for the current S3 object so I can run a small tokenization/inference smoke test before you re-mirror? I want to check roundtrip tokenization and sample decode.

mike: Creating presign now. Will re-run mirror with `--include tokenizer.json --manifest-version v2` after we confirm the HF commit. ETA ~30m.

deploy-bot: mirror-worker-45: presign created for onboard/zeta-13b/2026-03-10/payload.tar.lz4 -> https://presign.redwood/artifacts/6592 (ttl=3600s)

sophia: Quick sanity commands you can run locally:

```
# check s3 metadata/checksum
aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-artifacts --key onboard/zeta-13b/2026-03-10/payload.tar.lz4 --query Checksum

# download tokenizer to inspect
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-artifacts/onboard/zeta-13b/2026-03-10/tokenizer.json ./tokenizer.json
cat tokenizer.json | jq '.pad_token, .eos_token'
```

Also FYI: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e is the MD5 for an empty file — suggests upload truncated. If mirror job uses multipart and the last part didn't finalize we get size 0.

ada: Thanks. If re-mirror doesn't fix it, let's gate zeta-13b from the hosted catalog until manifest + tokenizer flags reconcile. Add to rollout checklist as a hard fail on checksum/tokenizer-flag mismatch.

mike: Will add checklist item and set MIRROR_SAFE_UPSERT=1 to avoid zero-byte overwrites. I'll post logs here when re-run finishes.

jordan: copy that — will try presign link now and report tokenization sample in this thread. :thumbsup:
